description:
This process kicks off when a department identifies the need for a new hire.
HR creates a job description and posts it on job boards.
Resumes are collected and screened, followed by initial phone interviews.
Selected candidates are invited for in-person or virtual interviews depending on each candidate's preference.
Once a candidate is chosen, an offer is extended, and salary negotiations may take place.
After the offer is accepted, the onboarding process begins, including paperwork, orientation, and training.
The process concludes once all onboarding steps are completed and the new hire is fully integrated into the team.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Hiring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/hiring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OfferAcceptance" name="Offer acceptance"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Hiring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_HiringOrganization" name="Hiring organization" processRef="Process_Hiring"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Candidate" name="Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ResumeSubmission" name="Resume submission" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InterviewInvitation" name="Interview invitation" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Participant_Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneInterview" name="Phone interview participation" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InPersonInterview" name="In-person interview participation" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_VirtualInterview" name="Virtual interview participation" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Participant_Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NegotiationToCandidate" name="Salary negotiation" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Participant_Candidate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NegotiationFromCandidate" name="Salary negotiation" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OfferAcceptance" name="Offer acceptance" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance" sourceRef="Participant_Candidate" targetRef="Event_OfferAccepted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="Hiring and onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Department identifies need for a new hire">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_CreateDescription</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_CreateDescription</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreateDescription_PostJob</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJob" name="Post job on job boards">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreateDescription_PostJob</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostJob_CollectResumes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostJob_CollectResumes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectResumes_ScreenResumes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectResumes_ScreenResumes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ScreenResumes_PhoneInterview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterview" name="Conduct initial phone interviews">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ScreenResumes_PhoneInterview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneInterview_SelectCandidates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectInterviewCandidates" name="Select candidates for interviews">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneInterview_SelectCandidates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectCandidates_Invite</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteCandidates" name="Invite selected candidates for interviews">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectCandidates_Invite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invite_InterviewPreference</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewPreference" name="Candidate interview preference">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invite_InterviewPreference</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Preference_InPerson</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Preference_Virtual</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Preference_InPerson</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InPerson_InterviewMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Preference_Virtual</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Virtual_InterviewMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Interview route merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InPerson_InterviewMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Virtual_InterviewMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InterviewMerge_ChooseCandidate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseCandidate" name="Choose candidate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InterviewMerge_ChooseCandidate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseCandidate_ExtendOffer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseCandidate_ExtendOffer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExtendOffer_NegotiationDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationDecision" name="Salary negotiation takes place?" default="Flow_SkipNegotiation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExtendOffer_NegotiationDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NegotiationNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SkipNegotiation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NegotiationNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Negotiate_OfferAcceptance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" name="Negotiation path merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Negotiate_OfferAcceptance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SkipNegotiation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NegotiationMerge_OfferAccepted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferAccepted" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NegotiationMerge_OfferAccepted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferAccepted_BeginOnboarding</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OfferAcceptance" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BeginOnboarding" name="Begin onboarding">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferAccepted_BeginOnboarding</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeginOnboarding_OnboardingSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OnboardingSplit" name="Start required onboarding steps">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeginOnboarding_OnboardingSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnboardingSplit_Paperwork</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnboardingSplit_Orientation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnboardingSplit_Training</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete paperwork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnboardingSplit_Paperwork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Paperwork_OnboardingJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideOrientation" name="Provide orientation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnboardingSplit_Orientation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Orientation_OnboardingJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnboardingSplit_Training</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_OnboardingJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OnboardingJoin" name="All onboarding steps completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Paperwork_OnboardingJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Orientation_OnboardingJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_OnboardingJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnboardingJoin_Integrated</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Integrated" name="New hire fully integrated into the team">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnboardingJoin_Integrated</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CreateDescription" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateDescription_PostJob" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJob"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostJob_CollectResumes" sourceRef="Task_PostJob" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectResumes_ScreenResumes" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ScreenResumes_PhoneInterview" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneInterview_SelectCandidates" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterview" targetRef="Task_SelectInterviewCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectCandidates_Invite" sourceRef="Task_SelectInterviewCandidates" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite_InterviewPreference" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preference_InPerson" name="In-person preferred" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Candidate prefers an in-person interview</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preference_Virtual" name="Virtual preferred" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Candidate prefers a virtual interview</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InPerson_InterviewMerge" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Virtual_InterviewMerge" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewMerge_ChooseCandidate" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ChooseCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseCandidate_ExtendOffer" sourceRef="Task_ChooseCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtendOffer_NegotiationDecision" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiationNeeded" name="Negotiation takes place" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationDecision" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Salary negotiation takes place</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipNegotiation" name="No negotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationDecision" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_OfferAcceptance" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiationMerge_OfferAccepted" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferAccepted_BeginOnboarding" sourceRef="Event_OfferAccepted" targetRef="Task_BeginOnboarding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeginOnboarding_OnboardingSplit" sourceRef="Task_BeginOnboarding" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnboardingSplit_Paperwork" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnboardingSplit_Orientation" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnboardingSplit_Training" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Paperwork_OnboardingJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orientation_OnboardingJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProvideOrientation" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_OnboardingJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnboardingJoin_Integrated" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardingJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Integrated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
